narrative_prose: The interior of the First Forge smelled of ozone and hot brass, a metallic tang that coated the tongue like an old battery, while the dry heat from the grate floors warmed the hand-forged brass instrumentation Silas calibrated against the low thrumming hum of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. Dust motes danced in the pale blue light filtering down onto the heavy blast shielding standing ready to DEFEND, the isotope cluster emitting harmonic frequencies to ATTRACT sympathetic ore, and the deep slag pit designed to CONSUME any volatile excess. Silas passed the warm copper calibration baton directly into Hector's hands, anchoring the unstable resonance field before it could breach containment.
